content:
We tracked reply rates on 2 lead lists for 90 days.

Generic ICP match: 0.9%
Signal-qualified: 3.4%

Same product. Same copy. The only difference was WHO we emailed.

Most "leads" aren't leads. They're rows in a spreadsheet.

The math on outbound tooling nobody shows you:

Data tool: $99
Sequencer: $97
Inbox infra: $150
Warmup: $79
Enrichment: $80
Verification: $49

= $553/mo across 6 dashboards.

We put it in one. That's the whole pitch.

A client asked me why their 40k-contact campaign got 12 replies.

Because 40k contacts isn't a strategy. It's a spray.

We cut the list to 900 accounts showing buying signals. Same week: 31 replies.

Targeting is the strategy. The tool is just plumbing.

What's your list-size-to-reply ratio right now?
